content: Yesus Nler la leta Yerusalema ralamni de riy ra'uli-rawedia

La'pa Yesus Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye'a re rhi' pa rwakriania Yerusalem noma rlola Betfagi nora leta Betania mak kdella wo'ora Saitun hananni. Noma Yesus Nhopan pa maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye'a riy woru rala' ulu

pua rla'a let maka ir rwakrian olek de. Yesus Nano'a re Niwra: “Hota la'pa mimtie'ela hande de hota mimkek nan memna keledai a'nani ida e nakniohu. Keledai de edonna rwatutu ma'ta nhia'ani. Ne mlieretniekla miewar doinia la pa miodia la handi.
La'pa riy ratian miy lia hya'a nrei pia mimpie'er doinia keledai dena? De mikot la miwra: “Itmatromlawanni e Nwaka (perlu) de! Ne hota Nnairia pa nhorwua de plet pa Enhopan pa amodi mai owa'ana.””
Dewade riy maroro'a re rla'awa, la' pa rlernana keledai trapriapi ida nakniohu lia puohra gaini walli tio'ora, la' talla aratni. La'pa e rewar rer mia'ta keledai a'na de,
noma riy dom mak ktutrier lia hande ratiana re: “Hoi! Hya'a nrei pia mimpie'er doini keledai a'na dena?”
Noka rwahla re rlernohora hya' maka Yesus Nakot targ oleka la ira. Noma riy re rollia ir pa rwe'er doini keledai de pa rodia.
Nhor nioka rodia keledai della Yesus nhor nia'nama rala ir rain plalahwani ra rwowa keledai de to'orni totpena Yesus Nha'a nana.
Riy harahu rtutga nhiu'ru-nhielma la'a rala naniair plalahwa ra rwowa la' talla, me korni rtuhia ora tawi-au tiawi motmota la'a nhyi'ini pa ra re'era la talla, totpena keledai de nlola wawannu.
Riy rahu re la'pa rlol gaini me mak ktawli'iru pa rletgar nana Yesus. Ne rhaunu-rhaun pa riwra:

content.text: “Ya'uli-yawedi nden rer tiy O' ee! Ta'uli-tawedi, tsu'ru-tselma O' mak mai pia kodia Orgahi-Orha'a nanni!
Ya'uli-yawedi la ray Daud upni-a'nani mak kmai pia Ntorna-nrautu! Ta'uli-tawedi, tlilili-tmamuau Uplerlawna la tutullu-lolo'oni!”

content: La' pa rte'ela Yerusalem dewade Yesus Nla'awa la Uplerlawna roma kreini. La' hande de Nlili-nloh momuoga, mere yoma lera nhi'pa nmel wa de Nlergot pa Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye'a termida wehrani woru re rokru leta Betania.
Yesus Nlokar wenna kar on ida
La'pa repar wa noma Yesus Nor mutwualli re rhoitio'or la leta Betania pa rla'awa dewade Yesus Naplar olek wa.
Noma Yesus Ndella oliet pa Namkek nana kar ona ida mak katawi olek wa, noma Nla Nwahak wo'oni pa Na'ana, mere kar on de nakleh wo'a. Mere tawni mamaini yoma kar wo'a lerni edon ntut ma'ta.
Noma Yesus Nhar lirni la kar on de Niwra: “Dodo'ondi mkieran wa pa hota omukleh wo' owa'an wa!” Ne maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye'a re mana e ratlin reria.
Yesus Nhokra-nlai mak ka'olu-kala'a la Uplerlawna roma kreini

La'pa rte'ela la'a Yerusalem noma Yesus Nla'awa Uplerlawna roma kreini herni-gaini na'nama Nhokra-nlaiya mak ka'olu-kala'a kaweli-kaphar la hande. Nte'la la mei-kader maka ha rwahernia kupna me mak ha ra'olu-rala'a ma'nu loktieru, pa Nkowa-nwalia.
Ne edonna Nhur dioinia riy pa rodia yohya' maka ha ra'olga pa rleret lia Uplerlawna roma kreini herni-gaini.

Noma Nakot la mak ka'olu-kala'a kaweli-kaphara re Niwra: “Edon miat niohora hya' maka ha rhorat targa la Puka ralamni la'a Uplerlawna lirni?! De Niwra: “Hota rweta A ro'mu de roma sniumbain geni la'a noha-rai honona la'a nohkerna-rai miaran di.” Mere miy e mhi'a la roma kamnelu-kamna' geni!”
Imam-imam o'tani-matni rora makwatutu-kwaye'a agama ratlin nan hade dewade rahak talan pa rwenna Yesus, yoma ramta'at E'a, onnila ramkeka riy rahu e rwer rer wiawni la E wniatutnu de.
Lera la nhelma dewade Yesus Nor wutga maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye'a re rwaran la let de.
Yesus Nwatut nohora it pesiayni la' Uplerlawna
Repardoin de Yesus Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye'a re ralala' reri de ramkek de kar on de nkern olekwa, nla meman la ga'arni.
Noma Petrus nhoratnana Yesus Nlokar oleka kar on de, noka nakot la Yesus: “Tungkuru mumkek la kar on maka Mliokar de nmati olekwa.”
Yesus Nakot la re: “Miy pesiaymi narur lia Uplerlawna!
Mhioratreria, he' nakot to'ola wo'or di pa nwarei lia tah'i lawna hota narinin la' tah'i lawna ralamni, hornama pesiayni edonna nwalera mere npesiay toto'a.
Mhioratreria! Hya' to' pa mimpiaka la'a miy sniumbainmi de hota mimliernana, hornama pesiaymi de yana nwalera.
Ne la'pa msiumbaini, de mhioratdoini riy do'oni-halli, hihi'ini-yapyapni tiy miy, totpa Ammi mak kdella Ilyamou-Watyatoha mana Namou-nawitna do'omi-halmi.
[Mere la'pa miy edon mhioratdoinia rira do'oni-halli tiy miy die, Amlawanmi mak kden la Ilyamou-Watyatoha mana edonna Namou-nawitna do'omi-halmi.”]
Ratian nohora Yesus plolli-mneheni de ha nwatiawua hanmeni?

Noka Yesus Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye'a rte' owa'an la Yerusalem. La'pa Yesus Nalala'a la Uplerlawna romni herni-gaini dewade, imam-imam o'tani-matni re me makwatutu-kwaye'a agama, ror wutga Yahudi in letni-am letni rmai pia
ratiana Yesus riwra: “Tuna, he' ed mak ktemna plola-mneh della O limmu ralamni pede Omhi' nan hihi'imu-yapyapmu rena?”
Noma Yesus Nwahla lirni re Niwra: “A'g e giwra utian tek miy la'pa mimpiet nana, de hota Awuahla miy, de la'a he'a plolli pede Aghi'a hihi'a-yapyapi re.
Pede A'utian tek miy, de hota Yohansi makharani de ha nlernana plol della he'a? Uplerlawna onde rimormiori?”
Dewade honona re rwahu'ru ralma-riora wamueh'a pa riwra: “La'pa itwet la Uplerlawna ed mak kala plolli la Yohansi de hota Eniwra: “Ne hya'a nrei pia miy edonna mpiesiay e'a?”
Mere yana it twet la tiwra: “Rimormiori plolli-mneheni hade.”” Rakot emkade yoma ramta'at rer lia rirahu yoma honona rpesiaya de Yohansi de makwohorulu-ktatrulu id hade.

Pede honona rla' lir id pa rwahla Yesus riwra: “Ami e maplinga.” Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra: “Hade emkade, de A' muana edonna ukot wahyaria tiy miy la'a he'a mak kala plolli mai A' pua Aghi'a hihi'a-yapyapi re.”
